_comment: Tier-2: the DEM nodal variables must be added to the STRUCTURAL model part before its Initialize(), because the transferred wall conditions reuse the structural nodes. Pitfall (kratos.dem_structures_coupling #5). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The list the claim gives is split across THREE modules, which is the practical obstacle: DEM_SURFACE_LOAD and SMOOTHED_STRUCTURAL_VELOCITY are DemStructuresCouplingApplication attributes; DELTA_DISPLACEMENT, DEM_PRESSURE, DEM_NODAL_AREA, SHEAR_STRESS, IMPACT_WEAR, NON_DIMENSIONAL_VOLUME_WEAR and TANGENTIAL_ELASTIC_FORCES are DEMApplication attributes; none of them is on core. All of them resolve through KratosGlobals.GetVariable, which is the route that works regardless. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
